active-duel.en: Live duel in LiftDuels: your sets next to your friend's sets, the running score and a rest timer.
active-duel.sr: Dvoboj uživo u LiftDuels-u: tvoje serije pored prijateljevih, rezultat i tajmer odmora.

active-workout.en: Logging a workout: weight and reps for every set, warm-up sets and a rest timer.
active-workout.sr: Beleženje treninga: kilaža i ponavljanja za svaku seriju, zagrevanje i tajmer odmora.

active-workout-2.en: A workout with a suggested weight and reps for the next set.
active-workout-2.sr: Trening sa predlogom kilaže i ponavljanja za sledeću seriju.

home.en: Home screen with an AI plan banner, a Duel a friend button and suggested workouts.
home.sr: Početni ekran sa AI planom, dugmetom za dvoboj sa prijateljem i predloženim treninzima.

duel.en: Duel lobby waiting for your friend to accept, with a countdown and the workout you will both do.
duel.sr: Lobi dvoboja koji čeka da prijatelj prihvati, sa odbrojavanjem i treningom koji oboje radite.

plan-with-ai.en: Plan with AI: choose your goal, experience and equipment.
plan-with-ai.sr: Plan uz AI: izaberi cilj, iskustvo i opremu.

exercises-statitstics.en: Exercise statistics for the bench press: best set, estimated one-rep max and progress.
exercises-statitstics.sr: Statistika vežbe (bench press): najbolja serija, procenjeni maksimum za jedno ponavljanje i napredak.

img_6553.en: Duel in progress: your sets and your friend's sets side by side.
img_6553.sr: Dvoboj u toku: tvoje i prijateljeve serije jedna pored druge.

streaks.en: Streak card with a 12 day streak, the week at a glance and total points.
streaks.sr: Streak sa nizom od 12 dana, nedeljom na jedan pogled i ukupnim bodovima.

img_6550.en: Challenges with daily and weekly goals, progress bars and completed badges.
img_6550.sr: Izazovi sa dnevnim i nedeljnim ciljevima, trakama napretka i završenim značkama.

muscle-new.en: Muscle recovery map, front and back, showing which muscles are recovered.
muscle-new.sr: Mapa oporavka mišića, spreda i otpozadi, pokazuje koji su mišići oporavljeni.

weekly-report.en: Weekly report with workouts, sets, volume and time compared with the week before.
weekly-report.sr: Nedeljni izveštaj sa treninzima, serijama, volumenom i vremenom u odnosu na prethodnu nedelju.

monthly-history.en: Monthly training calendar with the days you trained highlighted.
monthly-history.sr: Mesečni kalendar treninga sa istaknutim danima kada si trenirao.
